page_title: GEN 2-0 MON | Genoa v Monza 27/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
90+3' The linesman points to the corner flag, Genoa are going to take it.

90+2' Koni De Winter (Genoa) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up in the roof of the net, but Stefano Turati pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
90+1' Genoa will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
87' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
86' Patrick Vieira has decided to substitute Fabio Miretti and he is replaced by Vitinha (Genoa).
86' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Morten Thorsby walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jeff Ekhator (Genoa).
84' 2 - 0 Goal! Johan Vasquez (Genoa) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Maxwel Cornet and easily beat the keeper with a header into the bottom left corner from close range. 2:0.
83' The corner from Aaron Martin (Genoa) is hurriedly cleared.
82' The corner from Aaron Martin (Genoa) is intercepted by the defence.

81' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) bursts into the penalty area with the ball at his feet after a wonderful individual effort that left fans breathless and in awe. However, he sends the ball in a completely different direction than intended, well wide of the target.
78' Andrea Carboni (Monza) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
77' Patrick Vieira prepares a substitution. Andrea Pinamonti is replaced by Caleb Ekuban (Genoa).
75' The ball possession is 49:51.
74' Substitution. Danilo D'Ambrosio is replaced by Stefan Lekovic (Monza).
71' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Daniele Doveri who sees an offensive foul.
69' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
68' Here is a change. Daniel Maldini is going off and Salvatore Bocchetti gives the last tactical orders to Andrea Petagna (Monza).
68' The game has come to an end for Gianluca Caprari. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Samuele Vignato (Monza).
65' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
64' Alessandro Bianco (Monza) will miss the next game.
62' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Alessandro Bianco (Monza) is given a yellow card.

61' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Aaron Martin flights the free kick into the box, where Koni De Winter (Genoa) peels off his marker and heads straight into the left side of the net from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 1:0.
61' It seemed like Aaron Martin (Genoa) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
60' A cross from Morten Thorsby (Genoa) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
58' The game is interrupted as Maxwel Cornet (Genoa) is flagged offside.
58' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a superb stop.
55' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lior Kasa departs the field of play to be replaced by Maxwel Cornet (Genoa).
55' Genoa will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
53' A header by Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) from very close range goes towards the bottom right corner, but doesn't get past Nicola Leali, who makes a brilliant save.
53' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) will take the corner.
50' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
49' The resulting corner from Fabio Miretti (Genoa) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
48' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monza.
46' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the bar!
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Georgios Kyriakopoulos is replaced by Dany Mota (Monza).
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Daniele Doveri has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Problems for Salvatore Bocchetti as Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Alessandro Bianco replaces him.
45' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
43' What was Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
40' The current number of shots on goal is 2:0.
38' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Aaron Martin (Genoa), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
38' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender.
35' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
34' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

31' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the bottom left corner. Stefano Turati anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
31' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) is going to take the penalty!
30' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
29' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul. Genoa are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
29' Genoa have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

29' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball towards the roof of the net. Stefano Turati shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
28' Lior Kasa (Genoa) fires a volley towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post.
27' A free kick on the edge of the box for Genoa. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
25' The Genoa players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
21' Koni De Winter (Genoa) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
20' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
17' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) takes the corner but it's cleared.
16' Chance! Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Gianluca Caprari, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the right post.
16' It looks like Morten Frendrup (Genoa) saw red with that tackle. Daniele Doveri won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
13' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Morten Thorsby (Genoa) heads on.
11' A crossfield pass from Stefano Turati (Monza) fails to find any of his teammates.
8' Daniel Maldini (Monza) releases Gianluca Caprari, who latched on to his perfect through pass and can continue with his team's attack.
7' Genoa are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
6' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
4' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) launches a cross from the corner, but Nicola Leali is alert to thwart the effort.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Genoa will kick-off.
Daniele Doveri is introduced as the referee for today's match.
